name: studymate
description: StudyMate — An Agentic AI-Powered Study Planner and Task Management Assistant (Midterm MVP, Phase 1)

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.start: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm start --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
